n: MIT RAISE AI for Wellbeing (Dr. R.O. Bott) curriculum
t: A 30-hour middle school curriculum on chatbots and fairness using a real or virtual Jibo robot.
steps: Find the AI for Wellbeing curriculum from MIT RAISE.
Copy the Google Slides to Google Drive.
Open the RAISE AI Playground in a browser.
Decide whether to use a physical Jibo or the virtual Jibo.
Check with IT whether students need accounts for the Playground.
Try the Jibo and text classifier starter projects.
Teach Module 1, the intro to AI.
